edge_thesis: Markets have just experienced a sharp risk-off shock across equities and gold while BTC has already shown relative-strength rebound behaviour. The edge is to fade forced liquidation in oversold risk assets with tight, asymmetric risk while keeping one defensive mean-reversion trade in gold. Counterparties are recent panic sellers, deleveraging funds and short-term traders reacting to volatility rather than fundamentals.

picks.why: Rebound above 61k after liquidation flush; favourable short-term risk/reward.
Large one-day selloff increases odds of reflexive bounce before trend reasserts.
Gold ETF closed near 52-week low after washout; mean reversion.
Crowded USD strength vulnerable to short-covering retracement.
Broad-market mutual fund satisfies long-term NAV-scored allocation.
